description_en: Creates and attaches tags to cloud resources. For resources that already have the specified tags, updates the tag values
description_zh: 为云资源创建并绑定标签，对于资源已有的标签，则更新标签的值
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center tag-cloud-resources --resource-type AppInstanceGroupId --resource-ids aig-0002 --tags Value=720p Key=Resolution --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagCloudResources

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. A maximum of 50 IDs are supported. You do not need to specify this parameter when the resource type is tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表，最多支持50个。资源类型为租户ID时不需要指定
parameters.name: resource_ids

fields.help_en: The tag key. Tags are case-sensitive. The key must be 1 to 128 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 标签键。区分大小写。长度范围：1\~128 个字符
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. Tags are case-sensitive. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 标签值。区分大小写。长度范围：1\~128 个字符
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags. System tags and custom tags are supported.

System tag enumeration values:
`System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`: canary release tag
`System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`: tag that prevents newly bound users in a delivery group from establishing connections

Custom tags: A maximum of 20 custom tags can be created.

Each tag key on the same resource can have only one tag value. If you add a tag key that already exists, the corresponding tag value is updated to the new value
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。支持系统标签和自定义标签。

系统标签枚举值：
`System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`：灰度标签
`System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`：阻止交付组新绑定用户建连的标签

自定义标签：最多可创建20个。

同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值
parameters.name: tags
